xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2364: swarm: per-slot failure isolation — one failed-merge slot freezes the entire issue's swarm

plan.title: swarm: per-slot failure isolation — one failed-merge slot freezes the entire issue's swarm
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The failed-merge recovery block is recorded per-ISSUE. In coordinateSwarmSlots (src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm.ts:328-332) a single block makes the coordinator `continue` past the whole issue every patrol: no merges of other ready slots, no dispatch, no GC, no finalization, until an operator runs `pan swarm recover`. One conflicted slot in a 5-slot swarm strands four healthy slots (live repro: PAN-2229 RUN-62, plus PAN-2528/MIN-867/LEX-1 frozen in the same cycle). Compounding it: (a) `pan swarm recover --action retry` is a de-facto no-op — it clears the block but leaves the conflicted slot branch, worktree, and durable completion marker in place, so the next patrol re-merges the same branch, conflicts, and re-records the block; (b) `pan swarm status` never reads the block, displaying a blocked slot as ready-to-merge; (c) recordStalledSlotRecovery blocks only the first stalled slot and returns early if any block exists.
narratives.Proposal: Store blocks per-slot: add swarm.failedMergeBlocks (Record keyed by String(slotIndex), like slotCompletions) to PanIssueSwarmRecord with legacy singular-field read-compat and migrate-on-write. Re-key the in-memory Map to `${issueId}:${slotIndex}` and make the API per-slot (getFailedMergeBlocks list + slot-scoped get/clear). Make the coordinator guard per-item: coordinateSwarmSlots no longer skips the issue; mergeReadySlots skips only blocked slots (with an action line every pass); requeueFailedSwarmSlots leaves blocked slots to operator recovery; dispatchNextWave keeps blocked indexes occupied and blocked items non-dispatchable. recordStalledSlotRecovery blocks every stalled slot individually. `pan swarm recover <id> <slot>` keeps its verbs but retry now archives the conflicted attempt via archiveFailedSwarmSlot before requeueing, so the fresh attempt cannot re-assert. `pan swarm status` lists all blocked slots and shows blocked rows as failed-merge instead of ready-to-merge. Update docs/SWARM.md recovery sections.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes to dispatch-time file-scope overlap deduplication (conflict PREVENTION layer already exists; this issue is the containment layer)
- No automatic rebase of a conflicted slot branch onto the feature workspace; retry means a fresh attempt by a new agent, not mechanical rebase
- No operator-less auto-clearing of failed-merge blocks; `pan swarm recover` remains the only exit from a block
- No new CLI flags or verbs; recover keeps retry|drop|handoff with the same argument shape
- No dashboard/frontend UI surfacing of blocked slots (CLI `pan swarm status` only)
- No changes to stall-detection thresholds or to classifyInFlightSlots lifecycle logic
- No changes to verifyAndMergeSlot merge strategy (--no-ff stays)

autoDecisions.summary: Keyed durable storage swarm.failedMergeBlocks: Record<string, block> by String(slotIndex), legacy singular field folded in on read and migrated on first write
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body prescribes 'record: swarm.failedMergeBlocks[slotIndex]'; String keys match the existing slotCompletions precedent in record.ts, and live frozen issues carry singular blocks that must survive the upgrade.

autoDecisions.summary: recover --action retry archives the conflicted attempt (archiveFailedSwarmSlot) before requeueing, instead of only unblocking and re-dispatching
autoDecisions.rationale: The 2026-07-10 issue comment reports retry did not clear the freeze: the conflicted branch and its durable completion marker re-classified ready-to-merge and re-recorded the block next patrol. Archiving is the existing, tested failed-slot machinery and guarantees a fresh attempt.

autoDecisions.summary: Blocked slots are excluded from BOTH auto-merge retries and requeueFailedSwarmSlots auto-requeue; only operator recover exits a block
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue states recover semantics stay the same; auto-requeueing a blocked slot would bypass the operator decision the block exists to request.

autoDecisions.summary: recoverFailedMergeSlot and clearFailedMergeBlock gain a slotIndex parameter (breaking in-repo API change, no back-compat shim)
autoDecisions.rationale: Multiple blocks can now coexist per issue; all callers are in-repo (CLI swarm.ts + unit tests), so a shim would be dead weight.

autoDecisions.summary: Status discrepancy fixed at display level in swarmStatusCommand, not inside classifyInFlightSlots
autoDecisions.rationale: classify is shared patrol logic; the block is not a lifecycle but an operator hold on the slot, so status overlays it on the reconciled view.

metadata.readinessReason: Only ready writer of deacon-swarm.ts in its wave: the overlapping siblings (stalled-slots-block-individually, recover-retry-fresh-attempt) are readiness:sequential, and status-lists-blocked-slots touches disjoint files.

narrative.Action: In coordinateSwarmSlots (src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm.ts:328-332) delete the early `if (failedMergeBlock) { ...; continue; }` guard. Compute `const blocks = getFailedMergeBlocks(issueId, workspace.workspacePath)` once per issue; when non-empty emit ONE action line naming every blocked slot and item (e.g. `[swarm] blocked slots for PAN-X: slot 1 (item a), slot 3 (item b) — other slots continue; run pan swarm recover`). Thread `blockedSlotIndexes: Set<number>` into: (1) mergeReadySlots — skip a ready-to-merge slot whose slotIndex is blocked, pushing `[swarm] skipped merge slot N (item X): failed-merge block — awaiting pan swarm recover` EVERY pass (never silent, PAN-2469); (2) requeueFailedSwarmSlots (src/lib/cloister/swarm-failed-slot.ts:81) — skip classified-failed slots whose slotIndex is blocked (a block is operator territory; auto-requeue must not bypass recover), with an action line; (3) dispatchNextWave — add blocked slot indexes to occupiedSlotIndexes (deacon-swarm.ts:808-815) and exclude blocked itemIds from dispatch candidates. Also update the conflicts branch of mergeReadySlots (line 585-594) to keep recording per-slot blocks via the new API. Keep all new logic non-throwing: a throw feeds the 60s advance-failure backoff.

narrative.Action: Rewrite recordStalledSlotRecovery (src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm.ts:736-753): remove the issue-wide early return `if (getFailedMergeBlock(...)) return actions` and the `.find(...)` single-slot selection. Iterate ALL classified slots with lifecycle 'stalled'; for each one that does not already have a per-slot block (getFailedMergeBlock(issueId, slot.slotIndex, workspacePath)), record a block with the existing stall note text and push the existing recovery-required action line. Slots that already hold a block are skipped without a new write (idempotent across patrols).

recover retry archives the conflicted attempt so it cannot re-assert; recover is slot-scoped

expected_outputs: recovery + CLI suites pass, including a new test proving a retried slot's branch/worktree are archived and a follow-up coordinate pass does not re-record the block

narrative.Action: Change recoverFailedMergeSlot (src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm.ts:665-734) to take slotIndex after workspacePath and look up the per-slot block. retry path: (1) archive the conflicted attempt by calling archiveFailedSwarmSlot from src/lib/cloister/swarm-failed-slot.ts with the block's slot (renames branch and worktree to *-failed-<ts>, appends supersededAttempts, clears the durable completion marker and the slot assignment) — add runGitCommand/clearSlotAssignment to the deps pick, defaulting to the same implementations the patrol uses; (2) clear the per-slot block; (3) apply the existing unblock task-operation and dispatchNextWave with the item reset to pending. drop path: mark item done, clear the per-slot block, clear that slot's assignment (unchanged semantics, slot-scoped lookup). handoff path: update that slot's block note only. In src/cli/commands/swarm.ts:154-204 pass the parsed slotIndex into getFailedMergeBlock/recoverFailedMergeSlot; when no block exists for that slot but other slots are blocked, the error message lists the blocked slots (slot + item + note). WHY: RUN-62 showed retry re-asserting — the conflicted branch and durable completion marker survived, so the next patrol re-merged the same branch and re-recorded the block; archiving guarantees the retry is a fresh attempt on a fresh slot state.

With slots 1 and 3 both blocked, recover drop on slot 3 marks only item-of-slot-3 done and clears only slot 3's block; slot 1's block survives
recover handoff updates only the targeted slot's block note and leaves the item status and other blocks unchanged
CLI `pan swarm recover <id> <slot>` against a slot with no block exits non-zero with a message listing the currently blocked slots and their items
pan swarm status lists all blocked slots and stops mislabeling them ready-to-merge

narrative.Action: In swarmStatusCommand (src/cli/commands/swarm.ts:555-623): read getFailedMergeBlocks(issue, workspacePath) (add it to SwarmStatusCommandDeps with the real default). (1) For each slot row whose slotIndex has a block, display lifecycle `failed-merge (blocked)` instead of the classify-derived lifecycle — this fixes the RUN-62 discrepancy where status printed ready-to-merge while the deacon held failed-merge.
